baseline: Frozen C7 d6, threshold112, actual Q4d PL download; A/C2/C5 unchanged
selection_annotation: Original training AH only; all 20 images have previously been inspected, no claim of fresh holdout
bright_protection: max(raw green in replicated17x17)>=192. No additions in protected region. Original Gaussian3 bright core+radius7 band is a subset, with no GT in protection. Baseline predictions preserved exactly.
fov_protection: No new pixels within8 pixels of original FOV boundary; baseline C7 pixels preserved
weak_support: Residual integer forest score>=candidate threshold outside original bright/FOV protection; original C7 mask preserved. No C5 union, no geometric dilation.
connectivity: No forced connection: new raw contrast-sensitive detector must recover paths with actual evidence. Evaluate skeleton, adjacent edges and false additions explicitly.
selection: Only unchanged hard-gate eligible grouped candidates; rank Dice+clDice then smaller trees. Final fit on original train AH only. Freeze model before old heldout/VK; no later retune.
post_selection_gates: All40 cases xAH/VK: bright core/band pixel identity and baseline-mask superset; each image nondecreasing Dice, thin/centerline recall and adjacent-edge coverage; each size/split/observer mean clDice nondecreasing; im0324/512 both observers thin and centerline recall strictly improve. Any failure rejects the candidate for next board release, no post-evaluation retune.
resource_preflight: Reuse C7 window/features/score/model; add<=8 trees depth8 and shared256 reciprocal LUT plus18 signed multiplications. Actual LUT/BRAM/timing required, do not assume fits Z2.
reason: Propagation causes weak false thickening; aligned paths have <0.7 percentage point thin gain at512 and cannot recover long missing branches. Improve weak-pixel discrimination using normalized raw contrast and fixed C7 score, not more bridging.
feature_schema: Original36 C7 features + frozen C7 score +18 contrast-normalized features. Integer reciprocal floor(131072/(max15-min15+8)), signed round-half-away atQ12, clip[-255,255]. No annotations/IDs/coordinates for inference.
fitting: Only original train AH and original C7-neg unprotected pixels. All positives+deterministic<=16384 negatives/case with inverse-sampling negative weights; fixed C7 model remains unchanged. 5 paired-image residual folds; this is internally reused training evidence, not external validation.
